ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a dielectric slab waveguide model: the middle gray region is the fiber core, labeled with dielectric constant ε1; the upper and lower regions are the fiber cladding, labeled with dielectric constant ε2; the incident angle θi is marked inside the fiber core relative to the interface normal direction. The problem gives ε1=4 and ε2=3.9. According to the specified method, first convert to refractive indices: n1=sqrt(ε1)=sqrt(4)=2, n2=sqrt(ε2)=sqrt(3.9). Because n1>n2, the critical angle for total internal reflection from the core layer to the cladding satisfies sin(θc)=n2/n1=sqrt(3.9)/2=sqrt(3.9/4). Therefore θc=arcsin(sqrt(3.9/4))≈arcsin(0.98742)≈80.9°. The given θi=85° is greater than this critical angle, only verifying that the condition is consistent.

method.method_draft: Read epsilon_1=4 for the core and epsilon_2=3.9 for the cladding. Convert to refractive indices n1=sqrt(4)=2 and n2=sqrt(3.9). Since n1>n2, compute theta_c = arcsin(n2/n1)=arcsin(sqrt(3.9/4)). Evaluate in degrees to get about 80.9 degrees; the given 85 degrees is only a consistency check that incidence exceeds theta_c.

method.method_draft: Treat the core ray as a plane-wave component in the slab. At the onset of guiding/TIR, impose equality of tangential phase constant at the interface: beta = k1 sin(theta_c) = k2. Substitute k1=k0 sqrt(epsilon_1) and k2=k0 sqrt(epsilon_2), cancel k0, and calculate theta_c=arcsin(sqrt(3.9)/sqrt(4)) = arcsin(sqrt(3.9/4)) ≈ 80.9 degrees.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个介质 slab 光波导/光纤近似结构，中间灰色区域标为 fiber core，介电常数为 ε1，厚度为 D1；上下包层标为 fiber cladding，介电常数为 ε2。坐标中 z 沿波导方向，x 垂直界面方向，入射角 θi 画在芯层内，表示相对于界面法线方向的入射角。

推理：按给定方法，把芯层内的光线视为 slab 中的平面波分量。在全反射临界条件下，界面处切向相位常数满足 β = k1 sin(θc) = k2。由于 k1 = k0√ε1，k2 = k0√ε2，消去 k0 后得到 sin(θc) = √ε2 / √ε1 = √3.9 / √4 = √(3.9/4)。因此 θc = arcsin(√0.975) ≈ arcsin(0.9874) ≈ 80.9°。给定 θi = 85° 大于该临界角，符合题意。
